criteria.text: Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $500,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Calculates the service credit as $12,000 (10% of the $120,000 monthly fee for 98.1% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $6,000 is too low.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (10% x $120,000 = $12,000) and flags the discrepancy with $6,000.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
